text: All cases pass. The fix is a one-line change in `deps/graph.py`: the cycle check now compares `len(result)` against `len(deps)` (the full node set, including implicit dependency-only nodes) instead of `len(graph)` (only the input dict's keys). Previously, when the acyclic portion contributed more nodes than there were keys, the check was masked and the cycle was silently dropped from the result.
